Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health. We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us. Meet the Team At Dexcom, our Enterprise Applications team supports critical business processes across a global organisation. This role sits within the Enterprise Applications Team and plays a key part in supporting, enhancing, and delivering solutions within our application ecosystem. This is a blended operational support and project delivery role. The successful candidate will act as a subject matter expert for ERP integrations while balancing production support, business enhancements, and project initiatives. The role requires the ability to manage multiple priorities, respond to business-critical issues, and contribute to ongoing transformational projects in a fast-paced global environment. Where You Come In As An Enterprise Applications Developer - Integrations You Will You act as the functional subject matter expert for Integrations and related business processes. You support business users by investigating, troubleshooting, and resolving production incidents, service requests, and process issues. You work closely with business analysts and business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into scalable solutions. You support Enterprise Applications Financials modules, including: Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), General Ledger (GL), Fixed Assets (FA), Cash Management, Financial Reporting. You support end-to-end business processes across Procure-to-Pay (P2P) and Order-to-Cash (O2C) landscapes. You partner with internal teams and third-party suppliers to deliver projects, enhancements, and system improvements. You participate in solution design workshops, functional analysis, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support. You support SIT, UAT, defect triage, release activities, and hypercare as required. You contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and help drive adoption of best practices. You build strong relationships with business stakeholders and become a trusted advisor for Integrations and Finance systems and processes. What Makes You Successful You will thrive in this role if you: You have extensive experience supporting and configuring enterprise applications and integrations across Supply Chain, Procurement, Order Management, Financials, Billing, and CRM ecosystems, including Procure-to-Pay and Order-to-Cash processes. You possess strong knowledge of enterprise integration technologies such as Oracle or SAP and architectures, including REST, SOAP, JSON, FBDI, Kafka, Canonical Data Models, and event-driven integration patterns. You demonstrate a proven ability to balance production support, enhancements, and project delivery, effectively managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. You apply strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills to resolve complex application, integration, and SCM-related issues. You build trusted relationships and communicate effectively with business users, technical teams, vendors, implementation partners, and senior stakeholders across global organizations. You operate with a high degree of ownership, accountability, and self-direction while maintaining quality and delivering results with minimal supervision. You possess a solid understanding of ERP governance, change management, release processes, and operational best practices within large-scale enterprise environments. You bring experience supporting global and highly regulated organizations, with exposure to multinational business environments, enterprise integrations, and healthcare, medical device, pharmaceutical, or similar industries preferred. Working Environment This role combines operational support and project delivery responsibilities. While project work is a significant component of the position, production support remains an essential responsibility. The successful candidate must be comfortable balancing both aspects and responding to changing business priorities when necessary.The role may involve supporting multiple concurrent projects while also managing business-critical support issues and enhancement requests. What You’ll Get A front row seat to life changing CGM technology. Learn about our brave #dexcomwarriors community. A full and comprehensive benefits program. Growth opportunities on a global scale. Access to career development through in-house learning programs and/or qualified tuition reimbursement. An exciting and innovative, industry-leading organization committed to our employees, customers, and the communities we serve. Travel Required Up to 5% Education And Experience Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Finance, Business, Computer Science, or a related field and 5-8 years of relevant experience; or Master’s degree and 2-5 years equivalent industry experience or a PhD and 0-2 years experience Remote Workplace: Your location will be a home office; you are not required to live within commuting distance of your assigned Dexcom site (typically within an hour’s commute). If you reside within commuting distance of a Dexcom site, a hybrid working environment may be available. Ask about our Flex/Hybrid workplace option. Language Skills: Must be able to communicate effectively in English. Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals. Ability to write routine reports and correspondence. Ability to speak effectively before groups of customers or employees of the organization. CSMi is an equal opportunity employer.

review_candidates.title: Beheerder automatisatie
review_candidates.description: Over Umicore Het aandrijven van de auto’s van vandaag en morgen. Schadelijke uitstoot verminderen. Unieke eigenschappen geven aan hoogwaardige toepassingen. Gebruikte metalen een nieuw leven geven. Als wereldwijde groep gespecialiseerd in geavanceerde materialen en recycling ontwikkelen, produceren en recycleren we materialen voor een beter leven Over Electro-Optic Materials Energie in de ruimte. Nachtzicht. Coatings dunner dan een menselijk haar. Umicore is een wereldleider in materiaaloplossingen voor de ruimte-, de optische en de elektronicasector. We bieden onze klanten niet alleen een gegarandeerde levering maar daarbovenop de recyclagetechnologie die materialen een nieuw leven geeft. Om nog beter presterende producten te maken en recyclage aan nieuwe markten aan te bieden, mogen we niet stilstaan. We moeten nieuwe methoden ontdekken, nieuwe oplossingen bedenken en nieuwe processen ontwikkelen. En dan kom jij in beeld. Wat jij zal doen Je werkt binnen de technologische EOM-omgeving en het MSR-team mee aan het onderhoud, aanpassen en optimaliseren van diverse PLC en robot gestuurde installaties. Je coördineert automatisering investeringsprojecten door middel van het inplannen, verdelen, uitvoeren, opvolgen en rapporteren van werkzaamheden. Je helpt mee bij het opstellen van een (lange termijn) investeringsplan met betrekking tot automatisatie Je doet voorstellen tot investeringen en optimalisaties en werkt deze uit vanaf voorstel tot uitvoering. Je past de veiligheidsregels toe en kijkt toe op de naleving hiervan Je staat in voor het inplannen en uitvoeren van preventieve onderhoudswerkzaamheden. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het analyseren en oplossen van complexe storingen. Je staat in voor het uitschrijven van testscenario’s, programmeren en testen van de installaties alsook oplossen van opstartproblemen en borgt deze bevindingen administratief Je verzorgt opleiding rond sturing en werking voor gebruikers/onderhoudsmedewerkers. Je adviseert, ondersteunt en bent aanspreekpunt voor diverse anderen medewerkers binnen en buiten de dienst met betrekking tot automatisatie Naar wie we op zoek zijn Je bent in het bezit van een diploma master of bachelor elektromechanica (of gelijkwaardig door ervaring) met specialisatie automatisatie en je hebt enkele jaren relevante ervaring. Veiligheid zit in je DNA Je werkt systematisch en planmatig Je werkt gestructureerd en bent sterk in analyse. Je beschikt over een goede kennis van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal. Je bent bereidt continu bij te scholen om je job in al zijn aspecten te allen tijde optimaal te kunnen uitoefenen. Wat we aanbieden Om de toekomst vorm te geven, tonen we vandaag al de weg. Als bedrijf én als werkgever. Onze bedrijfscultuur garandeert dat iedereen ideeën kan uitwisselen en expertise opbouwen, ongeacht gender, achtergrond of afkomst. We bouwen aan een inclusieve werkcultuur die gelijke kansen aan alle werknemers biedt, ongeacht hun diverse achtergrond. We bieden een competitief loon en alle voordelen zoals maaltijdcheques, groepsverzekering, hospitalisatieverzekering,...die je mag verwachten van een top employer.
